Ben, saw Filevine leaning hard into the Legal Operating Intelligence System story with native AI workflows and AIBlocks.

A category move like that surfaces more in-market firms than reps can realistically touch, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Ben, quick follow-up for Filevine.

When you reposition a category, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Ben, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
